whatchanged.screen.title: What Changed?
whatchanged.status.exported: Copied to clipboard + saved to config/whatchanged/changelogs/
whatchanged.button.notify.tooltip:
How What Changed? tells you about a modpack update:
All - toast, chat message and title-screen button
Quiet - only the title-screen button
Off - nothing (press %s or use /whatchanged)
Click to switch.
whatchanged.header.world: Recipes, biomes, structures, enchantments and dimensions of the current world
whatchanged.note.removed_items: Removed items disappear from inventories, chests and the world!
whatchanged.note.uncomparable: Game version changed (%s → %s): changed recipes can't be compared this time.
whatchanged.note.hidden_recipes: + %s new recipes for new items (see the Items tab) are not listed.
whatchanged.note.unexplored: New biomes and structures only generate in unexplored chunks.
whatchanged.note.configs: Includes settings you changed yourself in mod option screens.
whatchanged.world.crafted_legend: ★ = you have crafted this item before (%s)
whatchanged.tooltip.loader: Changelog (also linked in the Markdown export):
whatchanged.empty.pack.2: Snapshot of your mods, items and mobs saved: %s
whatchanged.empty.pack.3: Update, add or remove mods and start the game again -
whatchanged.empty.pack.4: this screen will then list everything that changed.
whatchanged.empty.pack.5: Recipes, biomes and structures are tracked per world: see 'This world'.
whatchanged.empty.mods: No mods were added, removed or updated.
whatchanged.empty.items: No items were added or removed.
whatchanged.empty.mobs: No mobs or entities were added or removed.
whatchanged.empty.configs: No config files were added, removed or changed.
whatchanged.empty.configs.off: Config tracking is off (trackConfigs in config/whatchanged/config.json).
whatchanged.empty.server.2: Recipe and worldgen changes are tracked by the server when
whatchanged.empty.server.3: What Changed? is installed there (summary appears in chat).
whatchanged.empty.noworld.1: Open a singleplayer world to see its changes.
whatchanged.empty.noworld.2: Each world remembers its own recipes, biomes and structures,
whatchanged.empty.noworld.3: because they depend on the world's datapacks.
whatchanged.empty.world.1: No recipe or worldgen changes in this world.
whatchanged.empty.world.2: (The first visit after installing only saves a snapshot.)
whatchanged.toast.changed.title: Your modpack changed!
whatchanged.toast.first.title: What Changed? is watching
whatchanged.toast.first.body: You'll see what changed after your next update.
whatchanged.chat.crafted.one: Including a recipe you've crafted before!
whatchanged.cmd.not_ready: Still checking this world, try again in a moment.
whatchanged.cmd.no_changes: No recipe or worldgen changes recorded for this world.
whatchanged.cmd.reset: Forgot this world's history; the current state is the new baseline.
whatchanged.cmd.reset_pack: Forgot the modpack history; the current state is the new baseline.
